title: Nepal holds its first multiparty legislative election since 1959.
text: General elections were held in Nepal on 12 May 1991, to elect 205 members to the House of Representatives. The elections were the first multi-party elections since 1959 and were a result of the 1990 revolution forcing King Birendra to restore a multi-party system.

title: चिनो

title: युगदेखि युगसम्म
text: युगदेखि युगसम्म एक नेपाली कथानक चलचित्र हो । यो नायक राजेश हमालको पहिलो नेपाली चलचित्र थियो। यो चलचित्र निकै राम्रो व्यापार गर्न सफल चलचित्र हो।

title: Chino
text: Chino is a Nepali action drama film written and directed by Tulsi Ghimire. The film featured an ensemble cast of Shiva Shrestha, Bhuwan K.C., Sunil Thapa, Kristi Mainali, Sharmila Malla, Subhadra Adhikari, Shravan Ghimire, Sinaura Mistry, Anoop Malla and Sushila Raymajhi.

title: Yug Dekhi Yug Samma
text: Yug Dekhi Yug Samma is a 1991 Nepalese film directed by Deepak Rayamajhi and starring Rajesh Hamal, and Kristi Mainali. This is Hamal's first Nepali movie as a lead actor.
